# PickTheRobot

> Free rules-based tool that helps businesses pick warehouse, cleaning, and restaurant robots — robot type, buy vs lease vs RaaS, and vendor matches.

PickTheRobot is a buyer-side recommendation utility, not a vendor or concierge service. Recommendations are informational; users should verify pricing and fit with vendors directly.

## Primary action

- [Home — robot matcher](https://picktherobot.com/): Choose warehouse, cleaning, or restaurant → answer ~2 minutes of questions → get ranked recommendations.

## Categories

- [Warehouse robots](https://picktherobot.com/warehouse-robots): AMRs, AGVs, picking assist, pallet movers.
- [Cleaning robots](https://picktherobot.com/cleaning-robots): Office, retail, and industrial autonomous scrubbers/vacuums.
- [Restaurant robots](https://picktherobot.com/restaurant-robots): Serving, bussing, kitchen, and reception robots.

Educational guides (robot types, key definitions, vendors, FAQs) on each category page: append `#guide` to the URL (e.g. https://picktherobot.com/warehouse-robots#guide).

## Methodology

- [How PickTheRobot scores robots and vendors](https://picktherobot.com/methodology): Rules-based weights, sponsorship disclosure, and limits.

## Vendors

- [All vendors](https://picktherobot.com/vendors): Browse vendor profiles with outbound links to official sites.

## Humanoid robots (research tracker)

- [Humanoid robots hub](https://picktherobot.com/humanoid-robots): Readiness labels and when deployable AMRs/scrubbers are the practical choice.
- Profiles: [Figure AI](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/figure-ai), [Apptronik](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/apptronik), [1X](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/1x), [Neura Robotics](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/neura-robotics), [Boston Dynamics](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/boston-dynamics), [Tesla Optimus](https://picktherobot.com/humanoids/tesla-optimus)
